Guidde's Free plan ($0/creator/month) and Pro tier ($29, or $19/creator/month annual) sit alongside Scribe's free Basic plan and Pro Personal tier ($35, or $25/seat/month annual), so the free-to-paid-seat shape is shared even though the underlying format (video vs. screenshot) differs.
